snippet.title: Chaturanga // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732720/Chaturanga/

The ultimate chess variant roguelike game.  Start with pieces and the board set up for the ancient precursor to chess, Chaturanga. Defeat progressively more sophisticated computer opponents and chess variants while leveling up your pieces to their modern equivalents and beyond into new faery pieces.

Developed by
Bored Games LLC
